Instruments.spectrum_analyzer_signal_hound.WLAN Class¶

class Instruments.spectrum_analyzer_signal_hound.WLAN(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Bases: object

The WLAN commands control the receiver and measurement configuration in the WLAN measurement mode.

class Fetch(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Bases: object

The Fetch commands retrieve WLAN demodulation metrics.

__init__(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶
fetch(metrics)[source]¶

Fetch WLAN demodulation metrics. The integer parameter specifies the metric to retrieve. Possible integer values can be printed with print_fetch_WLAN. Can specify a list of metrics to request as comma separated list. The metrics will be returned as a comma separated list in the order they were requested.

Parameters:

metrics – Metric(s) to retrieve.

Returns:

Comma separated list of metric values in order requested.

set_center_frequency(freq)[source]¶

Specify the center frequency of the WLAN measurement.

freq – Center frequency in Hz.

set_center_step(freq)[source]¶

Specify the center frequency step size.

set_dsss_symbols(num)[source]¶

Specify how many DSSS symbols to demodulate/decode.

Parameters:

num – Number of DSSS symbols to demodulate/decode.

set_ifbw(freq)[source]¶

Specify the IF bandwidth of the measurement. This is applied as a low pass filter before the WLAN demodulation occurs.

Parameters:

freq – IF bandwidth in Hz.

set_psdu_decode(state)[source]¶

Enable OFDM PSDU decoding for BCC encoded waveforms.

Parameters:

state – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable OFDM PSDU decoding.

set_reference_level(value)[source]¶

Specify the reference level of the measurement in dBm. This controls the sensitivity of the measurement.

Parameters:

value – Reference level in dBm.

set_standard(standard)[source]¶

Select the WLAN modulation standard.

Parameters:

standard – ‘BG’, ‘AG’, ‘N20’, ‘N40’, ‘AC20’, ‘AC40’, or ‘AH’

set_symbol_offset(value)[source]¶

Specify a GI timing offset between -100 and 0 (%).

Parameters:

value – GI timing offset between -100 and 0 (%)
